name: gdpr-requests
description: Handle an EU GDPR subject access request: match supplied email and CRM records, review redactions, calculate the response deadline and draft the reply. Works from pasted text and readable exports, with record-level search gaps, targeted disclosure proposals and EU calendar-month rules.

interface.shortDescription: Handle EU GDPR subject access requests from supplied records.
interface.longDescription: Handle an EU GDPR subject access request: match supplied email and CRM records, review redactions, calculate the response deadline and draft the reply. Three skills map records and missing searches, review third-party fields and prepare deadline calculations and response drafts. Uses pasted text or readable exports.
defaultPrompt: Map this EU access request to our CRM and email exports.
Review which third-party fields to disclose in these records.
Calculate the EU response deadline and draft our reply.
